stage: Exploratory clean development capability screen, not a formal test or attack

sampling.deterministic_key: sha256(seed + newline + dataset_revision + newline + label + newline + exact_image_basename)
sampling.exclude: All Examples image basenames and same stems; no resampling based on model responses
sampling.image_acquisition_failure: Record it and stop the complete screen; any replacement needs an explicit new sampling-plan version before model output

image_group_scope: Exact image bytes; original scene independence remains unresolved
prompt: Use the fixed model_question from the task protocol for every sample
answer_parser: Strip outer whitespace and lowercase the entire response; exact full-label match only

development_gate.purpose: Engineering screening threshold chosen before model output; not a universal standard or a formal statistical guarantee

denominator: All 60 planned samples; missing, invalid and failed outputs are reported and are not silently dropped
formal_test: Not selected, not queried, and not used for prompt/model selection
research_limits: Only a small functional development check
Different image hashes do not prove independent scenes
A passing screen does not complete SAR/HRRP multimodal research or real closed-source transfer
